name: RES 2027 Annual Conference
venue: University of Reading (hosted by its Department of Economics)
call_type: Papers (General, Speed and Poster sessions); Special Session proposals
deadline_note: Deadline shown is for General Sessions. Speed and Poster Sessions close 12 April 2027, 23:55 BST. The RES page says applications to present at the 2027 conference 'open in October 2026'. Special Session applications are open all year.
submission_requirements: 500-word abstract plus the paper (PDF or Word); papers and posters can be in draft. One General submission and one Speed or Poster submission per person.
submission_fee: None ("There is no fee to submit")
registration_fee: 2027 prices not yet set. For reference, RES 2026 full-conference prices: members GBP 380 early bird / GBP 480 standard / GBP 535 full; non-members GBP 500 / GBP 590 / GBP 650; RES PhD student members GBP 190 standard / GBP 210 full
membership_required: Not required to apply ("You do not need to be an RES member to apply to present at the conference")
notification_date: General Sessions: March 2027; Speed and Poster Sessions: early May 2027
keynotes: Beata Javorcik (EBRD) - Hahn Lecture; Frank Schorfheide - Sargan Lecture; Imran Rasul (UCL / IFS) - RES Presidential Address; Ricardo Lagos (NYU) - The Economic Journal Lecture
